description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange w.e.f. 17.07.2017 to 23.07.2017
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges under the Customs Ordinance. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs valuation and compliance requirements, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5). While it names the Director General of Customs, this is only to establish the authority making the regulatory determination, not to announce a personnel change or assign portfolio responsibilities. The core content is purely regulatory in nature.
